mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile because the result explained both binding and release, connecting the sample to the arm's oxygen needs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making plasma was straightforward but less informative: the resulting picture showed its contents without explaining much about their roles at that point.

surprise.text: The description of haemoglobin releasing more oxygen where dissolved oxygen is low helped me understand how the carrier can supply working tissues.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. Each used a named component toward the stated goal, although the final addition did not explain what white cells and platelets do.

continue.text: I would choose to continue into another chapter to see how circulation brings oxygen to the arm. The explanation of oxygen release made that connection interesting.
